intervals.label: collaboration: detector manufacture and H-line construction
intervals.note: Start is the manufacture of the tracking detectors (2017), a lower bound; the H line was reported complete by March 2022 (arXiv:2203.07089).
intervals.quote: Four tracking detectors have been manufactured in 2017

intervals.label: collaboration: commissioning (last dated status: March 2022)
intervals.note: As of March 2022 DeeMe planned to begin commissioning in April 2022 and initial physics runs in June 2022. No later source was found, so the present status is uncertain; no physics result has been found.
intervals.quote: The H-line construction has been completed and it will become ready for commissioning in January 2022.

summary.plain: The international team of scientists who run the DeeMe experiment.
